newsitem.title: USA: Barrett abandons two Gulf of Mexico wells.
newsitem.headline: Barrett abandons two Gulf of Mexico wells.

text.p: Barrett Resources Corp said Monday it drilled two unsuccessful wells in the Gulf of Mexico.
The company said it junked and abandoned the first well, High Island A-364 1, after encountering mechanical problems.

It said the well encountered 61 feet of Middle Pleistocene Ang B' pay which was deemed to be non-commercial in the existing 315-foot water depth. Barrett is the operator and has a 45 percent working interest in the well.
Barrett said it is also plugging and abandoning the Matagorda Island 670 4 well after reaching total depth and testing saltwater from perforations in two Miocene Marg A' sandstones.
The company said it drilled the well on a Unocal Corp farmout. Barrett is the operator and has a 100 percent working interest in the well.
